Class EventNotificationService

java.lang.Object
york.studentevents.subscriptions.EventNotificationService
All Implemented Interfaces:
IObservable
public class EventNotificationService extends Object implements IObservable
An IObservable that broadcasts notifications about a single event to its attached observers.

Forms the subject in the platform's Observer pattern: an IObserver calls attach(IObserver) to start receiving notifications and detach(IObserver) to stop. Each instance is bound to one event (by ID) and fans a NotificationType out to every currently attached observer; the order of notification is not guaranteed.

One instance is dedicated to a single event. SubscriptionService builds one from an event's subscribers when it publishes a notification.

    • notifyObservers

      public void notifyObservers(NotificationType reason)
      Description copied from interface: IObservable
      Notifies every attached observer of a change to the given event.

      Called by the observable whenever an Event is updated, fanning the change out to each IObserver currently attached.

      The order in which observers are notified is not guaranteed.

      If no observers are attached, this method is a no-op.

      Forms part of the Observer pattern implementation.

      Specified by:
      notifyObservers in interface IObservable
      Parameters:
      reason - the type of change to the event; the reason why the notification is being sent.
